Frequently asked questions

Who do you clean for?
We provide short-term rental turnover cleaning for Airbnb and Vrbo hosts in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada.
What’s included in a full-service turnover?
  • Clean kitchens, bathrooms, and living areas
  • Wash linens at the rental and make beds with fresh linens
  • Restock host-provided supplies
  • Send completion photos
  • Flag visible damage
Where do you wash linens?
We wash linens at the rental and change them as part of the turnover.
Do you restock supplies?
Yes. We restock the supplies you provide at the property.
Will you let me know if supplies are running low?
We restock the supplies you leave at the rental. If you’d like a heads-up when specific items are running low, bring it up when arranging your first turnover.
Will I get photos or hear about damage?
We send completion photos and flag visible damage we notice during the turnover.
Can you clean between a same-day checkout and check-in?
Same-day turnovers available by advance arrangement.
How do I get a quote?
Use the quote form to share your contact and property details, along with your first turnover date if you know it.
How much does a turnover cost?
Turnover pricing depends on your property’s size and location. Use the quote form to request pricing for your rental. Include the neighbourhood, bedroom and bathroom count, and first turnover date if you know it.
What should I have ready before the first clean?
Leave fresh linens and any supplies you’d like us to restock where we can find them. We wash linens at the rental, so please make sure the washer and dryer are accessible.
Do I need to be there to let you in?
If you manage the property remotely or can’t be there, ask us about access when arranging your first turnover so we can agree on how to get in.
Can I schedule recurring turnovers?
If you need cleaning between bookings on an ongoing basis, mention that when we follow up about your quote so we can discuss your schedule.
What if a guest checks out late or a booking changes?
Let us know as soon as you’re aware of the change. A late checkout can shorten the time available for the turnover, so we’ll need to confirm what’s possible.
